caveats: Google Maps was reachable only in a 'limited view': star ratings were readable for four businesses but the review count was not displayed for any of them.
Addresses moved for several of these: CTSI and Excel now publish NY and Somerset addresses respectively, while Aspenn's North Brunswick address checks out but belongs to a 10-state operator.

Inference is labelled inline wherever used; unlabelled statements come directly from the cited page or listing.
data_gaps: Angi blocked automated access with Cloudflare (403 / 'Attention Required'), so the Total Residential Appraisal listing could not be read directly - details come from search snippets only.
The Manifest returned 403, so the BetaBulls profile (and the claim that a listing marks it closed) was not verified; the 'Permanently closed' status comes from Google Maps.
Google Maps limited view did not expose review counts for Kipcon, Excel, CTSI or Aspenn.
No review counts or ratings could be confirmed for PC Abstract Group, Total Residential Appraisal, Transmedia Wave or Cray Marketing - none showed any reviews.
